lineage.description: Building footprints and attributes were extracted from OpenStreetMap for Singapore through the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team's raw data API. The dataset includes approximately 124,600 mapped buildings with structural metadata (levels, materials) and address information, representing an estimated 63% of total building stock based on AI-mapping validation.
